 ORDER Heard and perused the record.

2. This first bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to Crime No.589/2023 dated (not mentioned),
registered at Police Station- Sector-I Pithampur, District-Dhar for the offence under Sections 376,
376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 15.09.2023.

sentences.text: 3. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that and he has committed rape upon the prosecutrix twice.
On the basis of which police registered the aforesaid crime.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
Prosecutrix and the applicant were known to each other.
As per the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C it is evident that the relationship was consensual in nature.
The applicant is in custody since 15.09.2023 and conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, prayer was made for grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Learned Govt. Advocate has opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
6. Learned counsel for the objector submitted that the prosecturix has no objection if the applicant is enlarged on bail.
Prosecutrix who was persent in person has also submitted her no objection in granting bail to the applicant.
7. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

8. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties, as well as no objection of the prosecutrix, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

9. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
10.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE sumathi Insaaf @ Shanu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123852556/
